verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability documented is in image generation, which supports batch generation of multiple images per request (grok-docs-28). Multi-image editing also accepts up to five source images per edit (grok-docs-30, grok-docs-8), but that combines inputs into one edit rather than operating on many items. Connectors such as Google Drive and Salesforce describe managing or creating records, but nothing says they act on many items at once. Missing for 10: a general batch/bulk API for text or other requests, bulk actions across connector items (files, records, emails), documented scale limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
